WITH weekly_gmv AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.net_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-03-03T00:00:00Z' AND o.ordered_at < '2025-03-10T00:00:00Z' AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'refunded') GROUP BY o.region), prev_week_gmv AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.net_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-02-24T00:00:00Z' AND o.ordered_at < '2025-03-03T00:00:00Z' AND o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'refunded') GROUP BY o.region) SELECT COALESCE(p.region, w.region) AS region, COALESCE(p.gmv, 0) AS prev_gmv, COALESCE(w.gmv, 0) AS curr_gmv, COALESCE(w.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(p.gmv, 0) AS gmv_change FROM prev_week_gmv p FULL OUTER JOIN weekly_gmv w ON p.region = w.region ORDER BY gmv_change ASC;

WITH weekly_gmv AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', o.ordered_at) AS week, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.net_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'refunded') AND o.ordered_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week' AND o.ordered_at < date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY week, p.product_id, p.product_name), prev_week_gmv AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.net_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'refunded') AND o.ordered_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '2 weeks' AND o.ordered_at < date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name), diff AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id, COALESCE(w.product_name, p.product_name) AS product_name, COALESCE(w.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(p.gmv, 0) AS gmv_change FROM weekly_gmv w FULL OUTER JOIN prev_week_gmv p ON w.product_id = p.product_id) SELECT product_id, product_name, gmv_change FROM diff WHERE gmv_change < 0 ORDER BY gmv_change ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH weekly_gmv AS (SELECT c.segment, date_trunc('week', o.ordered_at) AS week_start, SUM(oi.net_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'refunded') AND o.ordered_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week' AND o.ordered_at < date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY c.segment, date_trunc('week', o.ordered_at)), prev_week_gmv AS (SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.net_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'refunded') AND o.ordered_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '2 weeks' AND o.ordered_at < date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week' GROUP BY c.segment), current_week AS (SELECT segment, gmv FROM weekly_gmv WHERE week_start = date_trunc('week', now())), prev_week AS (SELECT segment, gmv FROM weekly_gmv WHERE week_start = date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '1 week') SELECT COALESCE(c.segment, 'unknown') AS segment, COALESCE(c.gmv, 0) AS current_gmv, COALESCE(p.gmv, 0) AS prev_gmv, COALESCE(c.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(p.gmv, 0) AS gmv_change, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.gmv, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COALESCE(c.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(p.gmv, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(p.gmv, 0), 0) END AS contribution_pct FROM (SELECT segment, gmv FROM current_week) c FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT segment, gmv FROM prev_week) p ON c.segment = p.segment ORDER BY gmv_change DESC;
